note: asserted by integration-tests.yml; raise only by adding tests, lower only by removing them. NOT ARMED (plan ledger D15-D17, human-confirmed 2026-09-23): the workflow's floor step is PRINT-ONLY, and expectedExecutedCount stays null until a GREEN 'Integration Tests' run on this branch has PRINTED its executed count; arming then sets it to that CI-printed number - never a local run, never the audit's '52', which counted FILES, not blocks - and fills observedRunUrl + observedCommitSha. Until both are set with a real number, nothing in CI is enforced by this file. Skip/flaky/todo bucket mapping (verified against vitest 3.2.4 JsonReporter source, not assumed): the JSON report has NO separate flaky bucket - a test that fails then passes on retry lands in 'passed', so executed = passed + failed is complete even with retries on; skipped / todo / pending are the not-executed buckets. This differs from the Playwright report the ported-from e2e step reads, which has a fourth 'flaky' stats bucket.
